_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: RELAY
parts.hint: The relay welded to the fallen cruiser's spine. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: DUNE
parts.hint: Sunder's dunes under two suns, the white one and the small red one the clans call the Debtor. Sand-skiffs sail them by day; armoured caravans cross them by night

parts.label: KEEL
parts.hint: The keel plating, where the flame is welded in bead. Caravan drivers touch it for luck on the way past

parts.label: RIBS
parts.hint: A dreadnought's ribs: the cartels parked them in orbit, nobody paid for station-keeping, and they came down one by one

parts.label: HULL PLATES
parts.hint: Torn hull plate the clans strip plate by plate. When a post needs a part, Tamsin Rook knows which wreck has it; scrap lizards sun on the hot metal
